desc:
Shopify SEO and speed optimization makes your store faster to load and easier for search engines to read. Ecom Swift LLC trims heavy images and unused code, fixes titles, descriptions and structure, and sets up your sitemap, then reports what changed.

## What is Shopify SEO and speed optimization?

Shopify SEO and speed optimization is the work of making store pages load quickly and making their content clear to search engines. Speed work covers images, apps, scripts and theme code. SEO work covers page titles, descriptions, headings, product and collection structure, redirects and the sitemap.

The two belong together. A slow page frustrates shoppers and also sends weaker signals to search engines. A fast page with unclear titles and messy structure still struggles to be found. Fixing both gives your pages the best chance to be seen and to hold attention.

## Why slow, unclear stores lose visitors

Shoppers rarely wait. On a phone connection, a product page that loads large uncompressed photos and several app scripts can feel broken before it finishes. Visitors leave, and the traffic you worked to earn is wasted.

Search engines have a similar problem. If many products share the same title, if collections are thin, or if broken links lead to error pages, your pages are harder to understand and rank. Stores also pick up clutter over time: removed apps leave code behind, and old redirects chain together.

## How the work improves results

Faster pages let shoppers see products sooner, scroll comfortably and reach checkout without frustration. That helps more visitors stay long enough to buy. Clear titles and descriptions help search engines match your products to what people type, and a clean sitemap helps them find new pages.

Rankings are decided by many factors outside any single store, including competitors, content and links. For that reason, we do not promise a position or a speed score. We promise careful work on the things within your store, with a before and after test, so you can see what changed.

## What good SEO and speed work includes

- Images compressed and resized to fit where they appear.
- Modern image formats and lazy loading for images lower on the page.
- Unused app code and scripts removed from the theme.
- A test of home, collection and product pages before and after.
- Unique page titles and meta descriptions for products, collections and key pages.
- Alt text for product images, which helps accessibility and image search.
- Structured data and canonical tags checked on product pages.
- Broken links found, with 301 redirects where a page has moved.
- A sitemap and robots file checked and submitted through Google Search Console.
- A written list of what is left for later.

## How we do it

We begin with speed tests on your key pages and a crawl of your store to list titles, headings, links and errors. This shows what slows you down and where search signals are weak.

Then we make the fixes in your account. Images are compressed and resized in batches, the theme is checked for leftover code, and titles, descriptions and alt text are written for your most important pages. We never delete an app without agreeing it with you, because some apps do essential work. We run the tests again at the end and give you a short written summary. The Basic, Standard and Premium packages differ in how many images and pages are covered, and the largest includes Search Console setup and a period of follow-up fixes. This is a one-off project, and we can talk about a later check once your catalog grows.

## Do and avoid

**Do:**
- Upload images at a sensible size before adding them to your store.
- Write page titles that describe the product in the way shoppers search.
- Remove apps you no longer use, then check the theme for leftovers.
- Keep page addresses stable once they are indexed.
- Test your store speed on a phone, not only on a computer.

**Avoid:**
- Stuffing titles and descriptions with repeated keywords.
- Changing page addresses without adding 301 redirects.
- Copying manufacturer text word for word onto many products.
- Adding a new app for every small feature.
- Judging speed from a single test run.

## Who this is for

This service suits store owners whose pages feel slow, merchants whose products do not appear in search despite good content, and stores that grew through many apps and edits. It also suits owners who recently moved platforms and want the search setup checked.

## What we need from you

Send your store address and a short list of the pages and products that matter most. Give us collaborator or staff access to your Shopify store. If you want Search Console set up or checked, we will ask you to add us as a user there. We never need your password. We confirm the plan with you before we change anything.
